events.summary: Sourcing analyst finished

Hangzhou Vistaray Technology Co., Ltd. is on time on 26% of its 43 closed lines, and its 32 late lines averaged 14.8 days late. It is the only supplier of Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110), which the Tern T2 (1 per robot) and Porter P5 (2 per robot) use, and of Lidar, 3D (HR-60120), which the Porter P5 uses (1 per robot). The need for HR-60110 is 262 a month. Halden has 1,753 EA on 10 open lines worth $2.91M, and 1 line is 2 days past due: HPO-26-00505/10 (248 EA, promised 23 September). HPO-26-00627/20 (314 EA) has no promised date, so it cannot show as late and needs chasing. PO-10710/1 (24 EA, promised 28 April 2025) is probably closed and is left out of supply until someone confirms it. Halden prepays 100% by T/T before shipment.

Lookout can't write the Recommendation yet. The sourcing review of Vistaray is still running, and the request to Xu Jia at Vistaray can't be drafted until that review reports back. The Recommendation waits on both steps.

args.body:
Dear Xu Jia,

We are reviewing our open orders with Vistaray for Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) and Lidar, 3D (HR-60120). Could you please confirm a firm promised date for each of the 10 lines below, on the terms of the existing orders? One of these lines was already past due on 25 September (marked below), and one has no promised date on our side.

HPO-26-00505/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 248 EA · promised 23 September (past due)
HPO-26-00357/30 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 44 EA · promised 30 September
HPO-26-00505/20 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 47 EA · promised 28 October
HPO-26-00627/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 338 EA · promised 30 October
HPO-26-00627/20 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 314 EA · no promised date yet
HPO-26-00627/40 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 38 EA · promised 20 November
HPO-26-00678/20 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 35 EA · promised 23 December
HPO-26-00627/30 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 293 EA · promised 28 December
HPO-26-00678/30 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 45 EA · promised 26 January
HPO-26-00678/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 327 EA · promised 28 January

For HPO-26-00505/10, please tell us the date it will ship. For HPO-26-00627/20, please give us a promised date. For the other lines, please confirm the dates shown or give the correct ones. Please reply as soon as you can.

Best regards,
Marcus Chen

actions.subject: Firm promised dates for open lidar lines
actions.body:
Dear Xu Jia,

We are reviewing our open orders with Vistaray for Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) and Lidar, 3D (HR-60120). Could you please confirm a firm promised date for each of the 10 lines below, on the terms of the existing orders? One of these lines was already past due on 25 September (marked below), and one has no promised date on our side.

HPO-26-00505/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 248 EA · promised 23 September (past due)
HPO-26-00357/30 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 44 EA · promised 30 September
HPO-26-00505/20 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 47 EA · promised 28 October
HPO-26-00627/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 338 EA · promised 30 October
HPO-26-00627/20 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 314 EA · no promised date yet
HPO-26-00627/40 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 38 EA · promised 20 November
HPO-26-00678/20 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 35 EA · promised 23 December
HPO-26-00627/30 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 293 EA · promised 28 December
HPO-26-00678/30 · Lidar, 3D (HR-60120) · 45 EA · promised 26 January
HPO-26-00678/10 · Lidar, 2D safety (HR-60110) · 327 EA · promised 28 January

For HPO-26-00505/10, please tell us the date it will ship. For HPO-26-00627/20, please give us a promised date. For the other lines, please confirm the dates shown or give the correct ones. Please reply as soon as you can.

Best regards,
Marcus Chen
Halden Robotics
